rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that you will try or make an effort.

example.english: Let's attempt to fix the old computer.
example.traditional: 我哋試吓整返部舊電腦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 si3 haa5 zing2 faan1 bou6 gau6 din6 nou5

rows.note: Use this more formal wording in careful speech or writing for making an attempt.

example.english: The company will attempt to improve the quality of its service.
example.traditional: 公司將嘗試改善服務質素。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zoeng1 soeng4 si3 goi2 sin6 fuk6 mou6 zat1 sou3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a neutral attempt or effort.

example.english: This was my first attempt at making a cake, and it turned out pretty well.
example.traditional: 我第一次嘗試整蛋糕，整得幾成功。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 soeng4 si3 zing2 daan6 gou1 zing2 dak1 gei2 sing4 gung1

rows.note: Use this when the attempt means the assault or attack itself, especially a physical attack.

example.english: The police foiled that attempt to attack people.
example.traditional: 警方及時阻止咗嗰次襲擊。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 kap6 si4 zo2 zi2 zo2 go2 ci3 zaap6 gik1

rows.note: Use this for a hostile or criminal attempt, especially an assassination attempt, rather than a neutral effort.

example.english: Police believe this was an attempt to assassinate the chief executive.
example.traditional: 警方相信呢宗係刺殺特首嘅企圖。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 soeng1 seon3 ni1 zung1 hai6 ci3 saat3 dak6 sau2 ge3 kei5 tou4

rows.note: Use this fixed phrase specifically for an attempted suicide, normally one that did not succeed.

example.english: They had to stay in hospital after a suicide attempt.
example.traditional: 佢因為自殺未遂而要留院。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jan1 wai6 zi6 saat3 mei6 seoi6 ji4 jiu3 lau4 jyun2
